note: Distinct padding / margin / row-gap / column-gap values (px) of visible layout containers (elements with visible element children) and margins of every visible element, per area; n counts element occurrences over all jobs. grid4/grid8 = share of occurrences on the 4 px / 8 px grid. sideMargins: per device, the left/right distance from the viewport edge to the outermost non-full-bleed content (page = the shell document, frame = the app document), min/median/max over jobs.
